results.title: Hofstra University
results.content: # Andrea Nadler is the Senior Associate... ## Hofstra University's Post. Andrea Nadler is the Senior Associate Dean of Admission and has served as an admission counselor for the past 23 years. I had a fear of public speaking, and I thought if I could become a tour guide, I would have it made. I came to Hofstra with no confidence, no leadership skills, and a fear of public speaking, and Hofstra built me. It’s been the best 27 years of my life, and I couldn't be more thankful to the university for breaking me out of my shell and helping me become a leader. As an admission counselor, I love building relationships with the students and their families. They are nervous about applying, they are nervous about financial aid and being accepted, but building these relationships and getting to know them, cheering for them as they get admitted, and going through the whole journey with them is the best.
